newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.

text.p: Compared Thursdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 70.50-71.25. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 70.50-71.50.
